title: As AI content floods the internet, Pangram raises $9M to detect it
slides: Could a startup unmask every AI-written text?
Pangram just raised $9 million for detection.
Most detectors fail on rewritten or translated content.
This tool flags AI even after human editing.
Test your own content today to see its blind spots.
thread_text:
1. Can AI hide from AI?

Pangram just raised $9 million to find AI-written texts — but most tools fail on rewritten or translated content.

2. The real blind spot

Even after heavy human editing, this new tool catches AI traces. Rewriting isn't safe.

3. What costs $9M?

The detection market is booming because businesses can't trust simple checks. Empty bluff costs money.

4. The cat-and-mouse game

If AI rewrites itself, detectors fight an endless upgrade loop. Tomorrow's model beats today's checker.

5. Test your own text now

Take a recent post you wrote and run it through their demo. What slips through? That's your risk.
